articles.title: Letter: the Stonebridge Trail Crew Did a Good Job This Spring
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Pine Road use it every week.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Pine Road for 33 years, and I want to say what a difference the Stonebridge Trail Crew has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Pine Road use it every week.
